title: Cascade Ortho Rider Schedule — Age Limits and Adult Coverage
content:
Under the Orthodontic Benefit Riders, age is measured on the banding date (the day the appliances are placed). On a rider with an age limit, the appliances must be placed before the patient reaches the limit birthday. An age limit of 0 means there is no age limit and adults are covered.

| Rider | Age limit (birthday by which banding must have happened) | Persons aged 19 and over may be covered | Date on which age is measured | Age at which a child's rider ends with the attached dental enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | 19 | no | banding date | 26 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | 19 | no | banding date | 26 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | 19 | no | banding date | 26 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | 0 (none) | yes | banding date | 26 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | 0 (none) | yes | banding date | 26 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | 0 (none) | yes | banding date | 26 |

### Reading the age columns

- On the three Child riders, appliances placed on or after the patient's 19th birthday fall outside the age limit. Appliances placed the day before that birthday fall inside it.
- On the three Family riders there is no age limit. Persons aged 19 and over may be covered.
- The last column is the age at which a child's rider ends along with the attached dental enrollment. It is 26 on every rider.

*Hypothetical example:* a patient born on a 14th of a month whose braces are placed on the day before the 19th birthday is within the age limit of a Child rider. If the same braces are placed on the 19th birthday itself, the patient is outside it.
